headline: Sensex and Nifty Rebound as Crude Oil Prices Ease and Global AI Optimism Boosts Sentiment

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Falling crude oil prices reduced inflationary concerns for the Indian economy
AI-driven optimism in US markets provided a positive lead for global equities
Retreating US Treasury yields improved risk appetite among investors
Domestic markets are rebounding after six consecutive weeks of declines
whatHappening: Sensex gained 564 points while Nifty 50 reclaimed the 23,400 level in the previous session
Hikal is incubating new animal health and personal care segments for future growth
The central bank may provide clarity on the potential listing of Tata Sons
The landmark NSE IPO is expected to impact the shadow market on Dalal Street
summary: Indian markets are showing recovery today as falling crude oil prices and global AI optimism support investor sentiment. The Sensex and Nifty have rebounded from six weeks of losses, reclaiming key psychological levels. Corporate focus remains on Hikal's diversification and the upcoming NSE listing.
